intention: `bin/cmd/probescan`'s `can_receive` must resolve the shim the real delivery path would resolve — the device's own registered shim when it has one, a DiscoveredShim only when it does not — instead of constructing a DiscoveredShim for every device unconditionally.
why:
MEASURED 2026-08-14, while dispositioning probescan's RED for an unrelated crossing. `can_receive` opens with `shim = DiscoveredShim(device_id)` for every id, and `DiscoveredShim._start_device` raises NotImplementedError by design. So the rung it reports is a property of that one class and not of the device: probescan is STRUCTURALLY INCAPABLE of returning `3-resolved` for anybody, ever, and its whole device column is a constant.

The reading that proves it is not an argument about the code: probescan reports `1-no-start-device` for the LIBRARIAN, and LibrarianShim()._start_device() returns a LibrarianDevice whose `receive` is callable. The one device on the roster that demonstrably can take mail is reported as unable to.

WHAT MAKES THIS WORTH A TICKET RATHER THAN A SHRUG: probescan's own docstring states the contract it breaks — 'Mirrors BaseShim.deliver step for step so the answer is the answer a real envelope would get: resolve a shim for the id, wake the device, look for the receive face.' It does not resolve a shim for the id. And `GroundLoopDevice._reconcile` prefers the real shim when both exist, so the path probescan claims to mirror already picks the other one.

AND THE PART THAT MATTERS MORE THAN THE FALSE RED: a check that cannot pass teaches nobody anything when it fails. probescan reds 23 of 23 today, it red 18 of 18 on the day it was built (dc16351), and a reader cannot tell from that number whether the world got worse, whether a device lost its receiver, or whether the instrument was never able to say otherwise. The genuine standing gap — nothing on the roster takes mail — is ticketed at `mail-arrives-and-what-cannot-marks-itself`, and THAT is the finding this constant is currently drowning.
traces_to: Law 3 — nothing is known until measured. A column that reports the same value for every input has measured nothing, whatever it prints.
Law 9 — red is the default and green is earned. A red that cannot be earned green is not Law 9, it is a stuck needle: it carries no information about distance from the spec, which is what red is for.
Law 10 — nothing in the system is immeasurable. The real shim is resolvable from the roster the heartbeat already owns; nothing had to be built to read it right.
Akien 2026-08-14 — 'we keep on until this whole skills and mechanical workflow is solid'.
gates: (1) RESOLVE: `can_receive` asks for the device's registered shim first — the same resolution `GroundLoopDevice._reconcile` performs, borrowed rather than re-implemented, because a second idea of which shim wins is the drift this ticket is made of — and falls back to DiscoveredShim only when no real shim exists. (2) REPORT THE FALLBACK AS ITSELF: a device reached through a DiscoveredShim is not 'broken'; it is a device with no page and no receiver, which is a different sentence from 'its shim cannot wake it'. The rung vocabulary gains that distinction or the report keeps conflating a deliberate design with a defect. (3) STILL DO NOT DELIVER: the existing refusal to invoke `receive` stands — a check that delivers mail has written to a record of truth.
falsifier: DONE when probescan reports `3-resolved` for the librarian and for ground_loop, reports harbor_master's genuine lack of a receiver as its own rung distinct from 'cannot wake', and its verdict line can therefore CHANGE when the world changes. WRONG INTENT if the fix reaches into DiscoveredShim to make _start_device return something, or if the rung vocabulary is collapsed so that 'no receiver by design' and 'wake failed' print the same — either one buys a green by deleting the distinction the instrument exists to draw.
horizon: One build. The resolution logic already exists at `GroundLoopDevice._reconcile`; this is a call site pointed at the wrong constructor, plus the rung the report is missing.

distinctions_recorded: A FALSE RED AND A STUCK NEEDLE ARE NOT THE SAME COMPLAINT, and the second is the worse one. The false red on the librarian is what made this visible, but a probescan that red every device correctly would still be uninformative if it could never do otherwise. The defect is that the output does not vary with the world.

THE VERDICT ON harbor_master IS CORRECT AND THE ROAD TO IT IS STILL WRONG. harbor_master genuinely has no registered shim, so 'cannot receive' is true of it. Right answer, wrong reason — and a check that reaches a right answer by a road that cannot reach a wrong one has not confirmed anything.

THE WATCH HAD TO BE WRITTEN NOT TO BECOME THE THING THIS TICKET'S OWN SUBJECT REFUSES. probescan's docstring argues that a probe watching all probes is the manager smell — an instrument, run when a hand wants it, not a standing collector. The obvious watch here is to fire probescan periodically and diff the column, and that is precisely the refused shape. The spec written on 2026-08-17 instead reads the output of runs a hand already made: the instrument stays hand-fired and the watch stays passive, and a stuck needle is detected by twenty identical readings rather than by manufacturing twenty readings. Recorded with its sibling finding: sorted_berth was null, so buildme_rides_the_sorted would have refused this ticket's first crossing whether or not the watch was ever specified.
intent_berth: none, because this is a bug: editing lines of code fixes it, and TICKET is the direct entry point for a bug (ruling 2026-08-02, three entry points). No new intention is being born — probescan's own docstring already states the intention this code fails to meet.

watchme.trigger: every probescan run — the scan is invoked by a hand, so the invocation IS the event; the probe reads the run's own output and nothing polls, and it deliberately does not run probescan itself, because a watch that fires the instrument it watches is the manager smell probescan's docstring already refuses
watchme.enough: when the device column has taken at least TWO distinct values across runs AND has reported 3-resolved for a device that later changed — variance alone is the floor and is not sufficient, because a column can vary for the wrong reason. Stop early and loudly if twenty consecutive runs return an identical column: that is the stuck needle back, and a needle that has not moved in twenty readings is the original defect whether or not the code changed
watchme.carrier: a verdict artifact against THIS ticket's falsifier: per run, the rung reported for each device, which shim was resolved and by which lane (registered vs DiscoveredShim fallback), and the set of distinct column values seen so far
watchme.nexus: ground_loop's diagnostic trail — the roster and the resolution both belong to the loop, and the consumer is whoever is deciding whether a probe has somewhere to send
watchme.consumer: whoever runs probescan before arming a watch, and the ticket mail-arrives-and-what-cannot-marks-itself, whose progress this instrument is what makes visible
